note: Re-judged 2026-11-14 by an independent auditor who authored neither 08fe903803 nor the uncommitted phase 2 of spec-single-owner-lifecycle-2-bgp-session. RFC 4724 Section 4.2 read: "The Receiving Speaker MUST send the End-of-RIB marker once it completes the initial update for an address family (including the case that it has no routes to send) to the peer." Units read: TestInitialSyncEORReachesTheSilentFamilyToo, TestRFC4724EndOfRIBNotSentBeforeTheInitialUpdateCompletes; only their sync calls changed. 08fe903803 moved the initial-sync gate (sendingInitialRoutes) and the End-of-RIB owed mark (initialSyncEOROwed) from Peer onto Session. In the tagged units named stale it replaced peer.sendInitialRoutes() with peer.runInitialSyncNow(), which is Peer.sendInitialRoutes(p.testInitialSync()) (initial_sync_helpers_test.go): the same production sync body, run on the session the fixture installed (or one built with NewSession(p.settings) and published through establishedSession as enterEstablished does); it replaced peer.<flag>.Store(v) with peer.testInitialSync().<flag>.Store(v) or setTestInitialSync, and drainAndCloseQueueGate now takes that session. git diff 08fe903803^ against the working tree shows no assertion, expected byte, driven input or tag prose changed in any of them, each under the RFC-approved line 08fe903803 carries. Questions 1, 3 and 4 answer exactly as the earlier judgement below; question 2 still rests on the same producers, whose discrimination records are retaken by ./le rfc record after this stamp. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Re-judged 2026-10-12 (independent auditor). SHIFTED by 4e731b2d96 (owner-approved lint-only reactor test edits). The tagged unit is byte-identical (gate-verified); the file-level changes are comment punctuation, slices.Concat over the same bytes, joined appends, strings.SplitSeq, newDefaultOriginatePeer taking its fixed addresses from constants with the same values, and registerTypeLenRecognizer losing a lo every caller passed as 1, none of which changes what a helper this unit calls produces. Verdict stands. Positive TestInitialSyncEORReachesTheSilentFamilyToo proves the marker is sent including for a family with no routes. Negative TestRFC4724EndOfRIBNotSentBeforeTheInitialUpdateCompletes: no End-of-RIB before the initial update for IPv4 unicast completes (plugin barrier held, sendInitialRoutes observed waiting, wire empty), then exactly that marker once it does. TestBuildEOR_IPv4Unicast proves encoding only. Rejudged 2026-10-12 after commit ce62c78c3b moved peer_initial_sync_test.go around these units: the tagged functions there were re-read and are byte-identical, their assertions and fixtures still carry the evidence this note cites, and the other cited units did not change, so the verdict stands. Rejudged 2026-10-12 after 7a637d6df5 renamed SendUpdateHeld to sendUpdateHeld in two comments of peer_initial_sync_test.go: every tagged unit cited here is byte-identical (gate-verified), the comment edits sit outside them, and the assertions and fixtures still carry the evidence this note cites, so the verdict stands.
